summary: Brindlewythe client readout (26 January 2026) for BW25_0600, Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd: primary potency and a 16-kinase selectivity sweep on 24 reserve compounds from the AP02 hinge-binder screening set. Plate acceptance met throughout; recommendation to take forward the reserve compound with the narrowest off-target fingerprint.

bullets: Selectivity sweep at 1 µM on six representatives against 16 off-target kinases

slides.notes: Plate acceptance first, then ranking, then the decision. Keep mechanism out of it.

slides.title: Plate acceptance
bullets: All plates: Z' ≥ 0.6, staurosporine IC50 within historical range
No compound showed signal interference in the counter-read
Two compounds repeated on day 2 after a dispensing error; repeat data reported

slides.title: Ranking
bullets: Potency alone does not separate the top compounds
The off-target fingerprint does: one compound hits fewer panel kinases above 50%
Two potent compounds carry broad off-target inhibition and are not recommended

slides.title: Next steps
bullets: Avernelwick to choose the reserve compound for the next chemistry round
Optional: full concentration response on the off-targets above 50%
